meta.name: LSD - Love, Scandal and Doctors
meta.description: Love, Scandal and Doctors is a story of 5 medical interns who got embroiled in a scandal. They are the prime accused in a murder. The question lies - Are these students even capable of committing such a crime or are they just being framed?

videos.title: Licence To Kill
videos.overview: The lives of interns at KMRC change forever when patient number 36 goes missing.

videos.title: Deja Chu
videos.overview: Inspector Tavish is the lead investigator in the missing patient Asif’s case. The tension among the interns’ rises.

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Inspector Tavish interrogates the interns. Will the interns crack under pressure?

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: The relationship between Kartik and Vikram changes with Sara’s entry. Inspector Tavish barters with Rahima to testify.

videos.title: Murder Revealed
videos.overview: Tavish questions Rahima about her relationship with Asif. The case of missing patient turns into a murder case.

videos.title: The Pressure
videos.overview: Kartik’s attempt to be a part of Asif’s autopsy fails. Inspector Tavish suspects the involvement of the five interns in Asif’s murder.

videos.title: Sex Drugs and Rock and Jhol
videos.overview: Chitra announces the cause of death to the KMRC staff. Tavish asks the medical staff to be cooperative with the investigation.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Each intern recalls their encounter with Asif at the party. What are the interns hiding? Who had the motive to kill Asif?

videos.title: Criminals Or Victims?
videos.overview: With the admittance of Asif as a patient at KMRC, the patience of interns was put to test. Sara discloses the reason for stealing the drug.

videos.title: The Cat & The Mouse Chase
videos.overview: Sara, Kartik, and Vikram are on the lookout for Rahima. Sara learns about Sam and Rahima’s relationship.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: A lethal combination of drug overdose and act of self-defence proves fatal for Asif. The interns attempt to deduce the motive and suspects.

videos.title: The Big Bang
videos.overview: Kabir gives details to Tavish about his interactions with Asif. Vikram is arrested, Kabir commits suicide.

videos.title: The Death
videos.overview: Kabir’s suicide raises even more questions. Sara is held guilty in Kabir’s death.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Kabir’s post-mortem rules out Sara’s involvement. Sam reveals the dark side of Dr Rana.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: Sam diverts the direction of the investigation towards Dr Rana. Chitra devises a plan to extract a confession from Dr Rana.
